title: stachys humilis
intro: Stachys humilis, commonly known as Dwarf Betony or Low Betony, is a species of flowering plant in the mint family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Stachys humilis include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and alleviate symptoms of insomnia. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
